facts.fact: The BCEAO list states that payment institutions are licensed in the UMOA under Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA, which applies to Cote d'Ivoire as a member.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services

facts.fact: The BCEAO list names ten payment institutions licensed in Cote d'Ivoire at 31 August 2026 (SYCA, Touchpoint Financial Services, Firstcom Global Payments, Julaya, Djamo, FeexPay, CinetPay Africa, Dunya, Paymetrust, Connekt4), the newest Connekt4 on 27 April 2026.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services
